correctness.rationale: For any shattered support, two specified labelings give pairwise vertex-disjoint submatchings covering the queried left and right shores to opposite unqueried shores; their union is a cut matching. Conversely edge subsets of a cut matching realize all patterns. The maximum-matching formula, complete-bipartite polynomial, forced-partner path facets and triangle boundary all follow rigorously for the stated quantifiers. Direct finite enumeration and an independent matching test agreed for 35,112 graph/support cases and tested the path construction.

value.rationale: A complete naturally motivated all-graph-class shattering characterization reduces an exponential concept system to a single matching certificate and a polynomial-time support test. The exact VC dimension and complete-bipartite polynomial show the invariant link; the forced-partner paths show arbitrarily large facet-size disparities even on connected trees, structurally distinguishing this complex from a matroid independence complex. These are meaningful structural facts beyond finite enumeration or a routine substitution.
